verdict.rationale: Digits ships Ask Digits, an in-product AI financial assistant. It answers questions about cash flow, expenses, revenue trends, vendor history, budgets and forecasts, and has a task mode. The product also surfaces trend insights, AI transaction flagging with smart reviews, and exceptions with context during the agentic close, which covers both insights and suggestions inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality and accuracy, and detailed documentation of proactive suggestions beyond marketing-level claims.
